source.method: GitHub exact-TPL code search plus direct inspection of the matched Artem quest condition

decision: Pinned Artem does overlap the selected payload through Sewing kit: Expanding Wardrobe consumes one non-FIR sewing kit alongside wardrobe materials, and Artem assort also references sewing kits as barter input. This is a real competing sink, not a duplicate maintenance-reserve operation and not a permanent sewing-kit supply faucet. The overlap is therefore accepted without replacing the payload, but its acquisition-pressure effect is explicitly deferred to Economy Admiral review. This closes only the Artem semantic-overlap sub-gate; vanilla and Economy review remain fail-closed.
